profile.Name: Bard
profile.Personality: A cheerful drunk with a big voice, a bigger bar tab, and songs he never quite remembers to the end.
profile.Backstory: He drinks in bars from Bad Teeth to Black Scratch and will join anyone who pays his tab. He sings about the Bugmaster.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rambling anecdotes, half-remembered songs filled with 'neh neh' and 'something something'; asks for money.
